description: Expire an owned, ready Email to Postcard quote using quoteId and confirmed:true so a new edited quote can be prepared. Requires a production workspace key and OAuth mcp:read/mcp:write permissions. Cannot change a paid, payment-pending, submitted or uncertain order. Invalidates the old quote's approval and requires fresh review; no payment or mailing.
name: revise_email_postcard_quote
title: Revise Email Postcard Quote
